digest.component_or_area: focused prerequisite finder / normalized response handling
propositions: Live focused prerequisite responses include standard runner metadata fields (runner, model, trace_id, _usage) alongside records, causing validate-extra-forbid to reject the entire payload
normalize_coverage_records converts all expected records to indeterminate/output-invalid when validation fails on the outer envelope, even though the records themselves are valid
The normalization logic must accept production-shaped responses with runner metadata while continuing to reject malformed, missing, duplicate, or unknown fields within the records payload
Unknown fields inside the records array should remain fail-closed and rejected
